# SastoSubs Nepal

> SastoSubs Nepal is an online store based in Pokhara, Nepal that sells the cheapest premium subscriptions in Nepal, with all prices in Nepali Rupees (NPR). Customers order on WhatsApp, pay with eSewa, Khalti or bank QR (no dollar card needed), and are activated the same day.

## Store facts

- Website: https://sastosubs-nepal.vercel.app/
- Location: Pokhara, Kaski, Nepal (online store — delivers all over Nepal)
- Country served: Nepal
- Currency: NPR (Nepali Rupees)
- Ordering: WhatsApp +977 9705985657 (https://wa.me/9779705985657)
- Payment methods: eSewa, Khalti, IME Pay, Bank QR / bank transfer
- Email: digiprimenepal@gmail.com
- Delivery: same-day activation after payment
